_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); defense prime contractor signals

pit_profile.why: 'In 2014, 79% of our $45.6 billion in net sales were from the U.S. Government, either as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor (including 59% from the Department of Defense (DoD))' (FY2014 10-K, Item 1); 'We depend heavily on contracts with the U.S. Government. ... Those contracts are conditioned upon the continuing availability of Congressional appropriations.' (Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, CLOUD (live from 2012-10-30) to public cloud displacing on-premise hardware, storage, databases and data-center outsourcing, ECOMMERCE (live from 2015-01-01) to e-commerce displacing physical retail, malls, grocery and distribution, and STREAMING (live from 2015-08-04) to streaming displacing linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles; the 10-K names no offshore competition, e-commerce or streaming and does not mention cloud, so no disruption theme in scope is live

(Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, CLOUD (live from 2012-10-30) to public cloud displacing on-premise hardware, storage, databases and data-center outsourcing, ECOMMERCE (live from 2015-01-01) to e-commerce displacing physical retail, malls, grocery and distribution, and STREAMING (live from 2015-08-04) to streaming displacing linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles; the 10-K names no offshore competition, e-commerce or streaming and does not mention cloud, so no disruption theme in scope is live. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +122% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.33; conservative 2yr -34%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -6.9%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +2.4%/yr (FY15 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.8%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LMT (retrospective, 2015-11-20) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (57.5% downside to Bear $96 / +-8.9% upside to Bull $206) | Adj composite 1.44 vs market 3.77: gap -2.33 [OVERVALUED] | +122% above the EPP floor $102 (9x FY15E $11.30) | Conservative 2-yr case: -33.6% total (-16.8%/yr) | At 20.0x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $299 sits above the BULL case; backlog -6.3% in Q3 2015, forward revenues -1.3% (FY15 net sales guide); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, CLOUD (live from 2012-10-30) to public cloud displacing on-premise hardware, storage, databases and data-center outsourcing, ECOMMERCE (live from 2015-01-01) to e-commerce displacing physical retail, malls, grocery and distribution, and STREAMING (live from 2015-08-04) to streaming displacing linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles; the 10-Ks name no offshore competition, e-commerce or streaming and do not mention cloud, so no theme in scope has dated evidence.
